ling-01:
brahmamurārisurārcitaliṅgaṃ nirmalabhāsitaśobhitaliṅgam |
janmajaduḥkhavināśakaliṅgaṃ tat praṇamāmi sadāśivaliṅgam ||
ling-02:
devamunipravarārcitaliṅgaṃ kāmadahaṃ karuṇākaraliṅgam |
rāvaṇadarpavināśanaliṅgaṃ tat praṇamāmi sadāśivaliṅgam ||
ling-03:
sarvasugandhisulepitaliṅgaṃ buddhivivardhanakāraṇaliṅgam |
siddhasurāsuravanditaliṅgaṃ tat praṇamāmi sadāśivaliṅgam ||
ling-04:
kanakamahāmaṇibhūṣitaliṅgaṃ phaṇipativeṣṭitaśobhitaliṅgam |
dakṣasuyajñavināśanaliṅgaṃ tat praṇamāmi sadāśivaliṅgam ||
ling-05:
kuṅkumacandanaleptaliṅgaṃ paṅkajahārasuśobhitaliṅgam |
sañcitapāpavināśanaliṅgaṃ tat praṇamāmi sadāśivaliṅgam ||
ling-06:
devagaṇārcitasevitaliṅgaṃ bhāvairbhaktibhireva ca liṅgam |
dinakarakoṭiprabhākaraliṅgaṃ tat praṇamāmi sadāśivaliṅgam ||
ling-07:
aṣṭadalopariveṣṭitaliṅgaṃ sarvasamudbhavakāraṇaliṅgam |
aṣṭadaridravināśanaliṅgaṃ tat praṇamāmi sadāśivaliṅgam ||
ling-08:
suragurusuravarapūjitaliṅgaṃ suravanapuṣpasadārcitaliṅgam |
parātparaṃ paramātmakaliṅgaṃ tat praṇamāmi sadāśivaliṅgam ||
ling-09:
liṅgāṣṭakam idaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet śivasannidhau |
śivalokam avāpnoti śivena saha modate ||
